import random
from django.core.files.storage import FileSystemStorage, default_storage
from django.db import models

other_storage = FileSystemStorage(location='/media/other')
def get_storage():
    return random.choice([default_storage, other_storage])

class MyModel(models.Model):
    my_file = models.FileField(storage=get_storage)
    class Meta:
        app_label = 'myapp'

# run deconstruct many times; storage kwarg must ALWAYS be the callable
for i in range(50):
    name, path, args, kwargs = MyModel._meta.get_field('my_file').deconstruct()
    assert kwargs.get('storage') is get_storage, (i, kwargs.get('storage'))
print('OK: storage kwarg always present as the callable (50/50 runs)')

# regression: plain default storage (no arg) must still omit storage kwarg
class M2(models.Model):
    f = models.FileField(upload_to='x')
    class Meta:
        app_label = 'myapp'
name, path, args, kwargs = M2._meta.get_field('f').deconstruct()
assert 'storage' not in kwargs, kwargs
print('OK: default storage still omitted')

# regression: explicit instance storage still included
class M3(models.Model):
    f = models.FileField(storage=other_storage)
    class Meta:
        app_label = 'myapp'
name, path, args, kwargs = M3._meta.get_field('f').deconstruct()
assert kwargs.get('storage') is other_storage
print('OK: explicit instance storage still included')
"
